requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area, so the total surface is used as a >= threshold. The 18-guest capacity is not converted into an area filter. Energy class and proximity to healthcare are not reference columns and are ignored. Turin is a city name, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set and is handled by the Location Agent.
User asks for the senior day center to be near healthcare services. Proximity expressed as 'near', so the threshold is the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.

The user requires energy class D or better, so buildings in classes A1 through D are included. Turin location, 360 sqm gross floor area, office-to-CDIA conversion, and proximity to healthcare are outside the energy-efficiency scope and are not filtered here.

output.explanation: Filters offices (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 360 sqm, energy class A1-A4/B/C/D, healthcare score >= 75, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point, ascending. No LIMIT applied.
